summary: Full E2E testing of Panou Antrenor (ElvisPro Cut) — JWT auth, projects CRUD, Emergent object storage upload, Claude Sonnet 4.6 AI plan generation, dashboard stats, Stripe checkout, and full UI flow (login, register, dashboard, projects create/generate/approve, billing → Stripe redirect). All 17 backend tests pass. All frontend flows work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 513 lines — approaching limit; consider splitting into modules (auth, projects, billing, storage) before adding more features.
stripe.error.StripeError catches in checkout are OK, but stripe library v14+ may deprecate stripe.error namespace — verify on next Stripe SDK bump.
generate_ai_plan JSON parsing (find first/last brace) is fragile if Claude ever adds a stray brace in text; consider using response_format=json when supported by emergentintegrations.
GET /api/plans hits Stripe on every call (3× stripe.Price.list). Cache in-memory or in Mongo to reduce latency and rate-limit risk.
CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — although auth uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), this combo is invalid per CORS spec and browsers may reject. Set explicit origins in prod.
No pagination on GET /api/projects (limit 500) — fine for MVP but plan for pagination as usage grows.
Storage key caching uses a global (_storage_key) with no re-init on failure; if key expires backend serves errors until restart.
test_credentials: antrenor@elvisprocut.ro / Antrenor2025! (seeded demo coach). Also created disposable TEST_ users via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral test users (test_<uuid>@example.com) and one test project which is deleted at the end of TestProjectsFlow. Frontend test also creates one demo project under the seeded coach — remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py runs full flow including real Claude AI plan (~5-15s). Uses pytest-xdist so classes run in parallel. Frontend Playwright: for /billing wait for [data-testid='billing-plan-card'] since /api/plans call is async; for /dashboard stat-total, wait for the specific testid rather than page container. Stripe redirect works — do NOT complete card entry.
